Data:Slnstg.morgen.yvette.json.desc: Morgen demonstrated an unusual interest in Yvette. [These two might say something else on the matter if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Slnstg.visiting.denzil.aladim.json.desc: Denzil and al-Adim shared a brisk interest in farriery.[These two might say something else on the matter if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Slnstg.visiting.denzil.arun.json.desc: Denzil and Arun enjoyed an unusually heated conversation. [These two might have more to say if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Slnstg.visiting.killes.corso.json.desc: Corso has evinced an interest - sincere or not - in Mr Kille's poetry. [These two might say more if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Slnstg.visiting.killes.morgen.json.desc: Mrs Kille addressed Morgen as 'Chaculette'; Morgen responded as if she understood the term. [These two might say more if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Slnstg.visiting.killes.olympe.json.desc: Mr Kille and Olympe have discovered a shared interest in the works of Noël Coward. [These two might have more to say to each other if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Slnstg.visiting.timothy.arun.json.desc: Reverend Timothy was excited to find himself at a Salon with the author of 'The Radical Measure'. [Timothy and Arun might have more to say to each other if you invite them both back for another Salon.].

Data:Slnstg.visiting.timothy.morgen.json.desc: Reverend Timothy hopes never to find himself in the same room as Mlle Matutine, ever again.

Data:Slnstg.zachary.morgen.json.desc: Zachary sought help from Morgen. [These two might say something else on the matter if you invite them both back for another Salon.]

Data:Soaked.json.label: Soaked
Data:Soaked.json.desc: In peril of dissolution! Intervene quickly, but not hastily.

Data:Sofa.grail.a.json.Label: Lingering Repose
Data:Sofa.grail.a.json.Desc: Upholstered in a velvet of peculiar richness that invites the hand.

xexts.scrutiny: Carved on the back by the maker: BE WITH ME, A LITTLE WHILE. Hearts and flowers have also been carved, by an unauthorised but skilful hand.

Data:Sofa.grail.b.json.Label: Delightful Repose
Data:Sofa.grail.b.json.Desc: Placed by the Curia of the Isle to allow a rest before an ascent. Or after a descent.

xexts.scrutiny: House folklore claims that Ambrose Westcott suffered his final apoplexy on this sofa, after a particularly hasty trample up and down the stairs to argue with visiting priests.

Data:Sofa.grail.b.x.json.Label: Delightful Repose
Data:Sofa.grail.b.x.json.Desc: Placed by the Curia of the Isle to allow a rest before an ascent. Or after a descent.

xexts.scrutiny: House folklore claims that Ambrose Westcott suffered his final apoplexy on this sofa, after a particularly hasty trample up and down the stairs to argue with visiting priests.

Data:Sofa.gullscry.json.Label: Soft Blue Sofa
Data:Sofa.gullscry.json.Desc: Gently complements the seas and skies around Brancrug.

xexts.scrutiny: Ambrose Westcott ordered the destruction of Valentine's bed, for reasons he did not choose to articulate. Much later, Brian Levinsen had this sofa installed so he could nap here.

Data:Sofa.knock.json.Label: Chaise-Longue of Conclusions
Data:Sofa.knock.json.Desc: Here the Librarian van Lauren lay, to ponder the paradoxes he had inherited from Harries.

xexts.scrutiny: 'Perhaps the faintest, driest voice murmured: 'The Librarian that comes after is not the Librarian.' Or perhaps that was only something that once we read.

Data:Sofa.russet.json.Label: Russet Couch
Data:Sofa.russet.json.Desc: A utilitarian item, arms varnished, upholstery shiny with hard use.

xexts.scrutiny: Did Christopher Illopoly really have this stolen from a first-class waiting-room? And did he really bribe a bishop to keep the matter quiet?
At each movement, a puff of dust arises from the cushions.

Data:Sofa.winter.json.Label: Sea-Green Sofa
Data:Sofa.winter.json.Desc: Here, Lady Eva Dewulf would weave her intrigues, and satisfy her secret craving for sentimental novels.

xexts.scrutiny: Lord Franklin Bancroft, magus and rake, was a frequent visitor to Hush House and his name was often linked with Lady Eva's. He provoked scandal with a lubricious encomium, Thy Throne Malachite, dedicated to this very item of furniture. Lady Eva took this badly, withdrawing Bancroft's invitation to Christmas dinner, but relented in time for her spring ball, on condition he attended dressed entirely in green.

Data:Souffle.aglaophotis.json.Label: Aglaophotis Soufflé
Data:Souffle.aglaophotis.json.Desc: One of the most deliciously melting incarnations of occult power ever contrived.

xexts.scrutiny: Doors can open to more than sight...

Data:Soup.leek.json.Label: Leek Soup
Data:Soup.leek.json.Desc: A milder taste than onion soup, but no less warming.

Data:Soup.pumpkin.amber.json.Label: Amber Pumpkin Soup
Data:Soup.pumpkin.amber.json.Desc: The amber 'pompions' of Brancrug are, according to tradition, all descendants of the seeds brought by Kitty Mazarine from her home across the soft sea.

Data:Soup.pumpkin.honey.json.Label: Honey-Haunted Pumpkin Soup
Data:Soup.pumpkin.honey.json.Desc: Harvey Hattington, perenially suspicious of the Blomberende-kind and their cuckoo-honey, nevertheless championed pumpkin soup made with cuckoo-honey as 'Savour's Consort.'

xexts.scrutiny: 'Every key has its lock,' Serena Blackwood once said, 'sounds much grander than when we say that every spanner has its nut. But both remain true.'

Data:Spencer.down.json.label: Spencer Hobson
Data:Spencer.down.json.desc: Spencer has been a number of things: journalist, private detective, priest, Suppression Bureau irregular. He's still a number of things. That might not be a problem. He's disinclined to speak.  He hopes to visit the Rowenarium beneath Hush House - to pass through it - to go 'down' somewhere [Take him to the Rowenarium, or refuse entry by returning him to the Endless Guest node. Note that Spencer arrives with Numa, but he will lurk in the Cornish mists even after Numa is over, until you resolve his business.]

Data:Spencer.out.json.label: Spencer Hobson
Data:Spencer.out.json.desc: Spencer has been a number of things: journalist, private detective, priest, Suppression Bureau irregular. He's still a number of things. That might not be a problem. He's disinclined to speak. He hopes to visit the Rowenarium beneath Hush House - to pass through it - to go 'out' somewhere. [Take him to the Rowenarium, or refuse entry by returning him to the Endless Guest node. Note that Spencer arrives with Numa, but he will lurk in the Cornish mists even after Numa is over, until you resolve his business.]

Data:Spencer.trace.json.label: Spencer's Space
Data:Spencer.trace.json.desc: This is where Spencer was. [Return this to the Endless Guest node.]

Data:Spicing.json.label: Spicing
Data:Spicing.json.desc: Tool, or knowledge, that might be used to add more exotic savours.

Data:Spintria.bronze.json.Label: Bronze Spintria
Data:Spintria.bronze.json.Desc: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Bronze spintriae usually display the act of shaping on their reverse side.

Data:Spintria.gold.json.Label: Gold Spintria
Data:Spintria.gold.json.Desc: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Gold spintriae display scenes that are not visible to mortal eyes on their reverse side.

Data:Spintria.iron.json.Label: Iron Spintria
Data:Spintria.iron.json.Desc: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Iron spintriae are the lowest denomination, and display scenes of murder on their reverse side.

Data:Spintria.silver.json.Label: Silver Spintria
Data:Spintria.silver.json.Desc: Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. Silver spintriae are more valuable, and usually display scenes of debauchery on their reverse side.
